title: Violent Games: A Hidden Impact on Behaviour
summary: Children who play violent games excessively display aggressive behaviour (fighting, shouting, bullying). Monitor what your child plays, and set alternatives that build skills without destroying their character.
try_this: Review your child’s games this week—remove any game containing violence or blood, and suggest alternatives: Minecraft (creativity), puzzle games, sports games.
reflection_prompts: How did your child react to the alternatives?
